arabic text: KYA QABR KA MANZAR HAI UJAALA NA HAWA HAI
english translation text: What a scene of the grave: there is neither light nor air.

arabic text:
NEEND AATI NAHI BACHON KO JAB TAK NA HO
MAADAR
PAAS ISKE NA MAADAR HAI NA BABA NA CHACHA
HAI
english translation text:
Children cannot sleep unless
their mother is near;
yet beside her is
neither mother, father nor uncle.

arabic text: ZINDAAN MAY KISE BALI SAKINA NE PUKARA\nIK LAASHA SAR-E-KARBOBALA UTHNE LAGA HAI
english translation text: Whom did little Sakina call within the prison?\nA body in Karbala's battlefield began to rise.

arabic text: ABBAS CHACHA AAENGE, GHAR LEKE CHALENGE\nAB ZULM YAZIDI KA KA BHARAM TOOTH RAHA\nHAI
english translation text: Uncle Abbas will come and\ntake us home; the illusion of\nYazidi power is now breaking.

arabic text: KHAMOSH HO TUM KYON NAHI BABA KO BULAATI\nTAREEKI E ZINDAAN MAY YE ZAINAB KI SADA HAI
english translation text: Why are you silent? Why do you not call Baba?\nWithin the prison's darkness, this is Zainab's cry.

arabic text: MAI BALI SAKINA KA AZADAAR HOO REHAAN\nNOHAY KA HAR EK SHER SAKINA KI ATA HAI
english translation text: O Rehan, I am little Sakina's mourner;\nevery verse of this lament is Sakina's gift.

arabic text: BABA NA JAAIYE
english translation text: Baba, do not go.

arabic text: ZAINAB NE DI SADA, ALLAH KA WAASTA, BABA NA JAAIYE\nHAR SU HAI AAJ KYUN, BADLI HUWI FIZA, BABA NA JAAIYE
english translation text: Zainab cried: for Allah's sake, Baba, do not go.\nWhy has the atmosphere changed in every direction? Baba, do not go.

arabic text: TAREEK HAI JAHAAN, AFSURDA AASMAAN, YEH RAAT HAI AJEEB\nGHABRA RAHA HAI DIL, KARTI HOON ILTEJA, BABA NA JAAIYE
english translation text: The world is dark and the heavens sorrowful; this night is strange.\nMy heart is frightened—I plead with you, Baba, do not go.

arabic text: HAI AAG BADR KE, YEH INTEQAAM KI SAAZISH HAI SHAAM KI\nUMMAT MEIN BUGHZ KI, PHELI HAI AB HAWA, BABA NA JAAIYE
english translation text: This is the fire of Badr and a plot of revenge from Shaam.\nHatred has spread among the nation, Baba, do not go.

arabic text: NAANA BHI AB NAHIN, AMMA BHI CHAL BASI, PARDES ME\nQAYAAM\nHUM SE WATAN SE DOOR, KYA HOGA KYA PATA, BABA NA JAAIYE
english translation text: Grandfather is no longer here, and Mother has also\ndeparted; we are living abroad. Far from our homeland,\nwho knows what will happen? Baba, do not go.

arabic text: PHIR ZINDAGI SITAM, PEHLA HAI USPE GHAM, CHOTA ABHI HAI\nSIN\nKAISE UTHAEGA, SADMA YE BAWAFA, BABA NA JAAIYE
english translation text: Life has already brought oppression, and grief has spread\nover him; he is still young. How will this\nloyal child bear the shock? Baba, do not go.

arabic text: WHO WAQT HAI QAREEB, BADLEGA YE NASEEB, BABA TUMHARE\nBAAD\nKARKE HUME ASEER, LAAENGE ASHQIYA, BABA NA JAAIYE
english translation text: That time is near; after you, destiny\nwill change. The wicked will capture us and\ntake us away, Baba, do not go.

arabic text: MISLE SAKINA THI, BETI ALI KI BHI, RORO KE MARGAYI\nNOHA KHADIJA KE, HONTON PE BAS YE THA, BABA NA JAAIYE
english translation text: Ali's daughter too was like Sakina; she died weeping.\nThis alone remained upon Khadija's lips: Baba, do not go.

arabic text: JAB GHAR UJAR GAYA, AUR AAYE MURTAZA, SHAAME\nGHAREEBAN ME\nZAINAB KE BAYN THE, SAR SE CHINI RIDA, BABA NA JAAIYE
english translation text: When the home was ruined and Murtaza came\nupon the night of loneliness, Zainab lamented: the\nchadar was snatched from my head—Baba, do not go.

arabic text: ABBAS AUR HASSAN, RUKHSAT HUWE ALI, AAFAT KI THI GHARI\nKULSOOM GASH ME HAI, ZAINAB NE KI BUKA, BABA NA JAAIYE
english translation text: Abbas and Hasan bid farewell to Ali; it was an hour of calamity.\nKulsum fainted and Zainab wept: Baba, do not go.

arabic text: AY PYAASI SAKINA KE CHACHA
english translation text: O uncle of thirsty Sakina.

arabic text: AY PYAASI SAKINA KE CHACHAJAAN DUA DO\nEK BAAR HUME KARBOBALA PHIR SE DIKHA DO
english translation text: O beloved uncle of thirsty Sakina, bless us;\nshow us Karbala once again.

arabic text: GHAZI TUMHE BEEMAR E MADINA KI QASAM HAI\nYE WAQT E KARAM HAI\nJO BICHRE HUWE HAIN UNHE AAPAS MILA DO
english translation text: Ghazi, by the oath of the ailing one of Madina,\nthis is the time for generosity:\nreunite those who have been separated.

arabic text: JO AABID E BEEMAR LAHOO ROTA HAI MOLA\nHAI WAASTA USKA\nSARWAR KE AZADAR MAREEZO KO SHIFA DO
english translation text: For the sake of that ailing\nAbid who wept blood, Maula, grant\nhealing to the sick mourners of Sarwar.

arabic text: SADQE ME USI KE JO TUMHARI HAI BHATEEJI\nHAI AAJ BHI QAIDI\nZINDAAN SE BE JURM ASEERON KO CHURA DO
english translation text: For the sake of your niece\nwho remains a prisoner even today,\nfree innocent captives from prison.

arabic text: JO JHOLIAAN AABAD NAHI HAI MERE GHAZI\nKHWAHISH HAI HUMAARI\nSHABBIR SE KEH KAR UNHE AWLAAD DILA DO
english translation text: O Ghazi, those laps that are not blessed with children—\nthis is our wish:\nask Shabbir to grant them children.

arabic text: HUM IS TARHA DUNYA ME SUKOON PAAENGE GHAZI\nJEE JAAENGE GHAZI\nSHABBIR PE MARNE KI ADA HUM KO SIKHA DO
english translation text: In this way, Ghazi, we will find peace in the world;\nwe will live again.\nTeach us how to die for Shabbir.

arabic text: SARWAR KI AZADARI PE WOH KHARCH KAREGA\nJAB TAK BHI RAHEGA\nHAR BANDA E SHABBIR KA TUM RIZQ BARHA DO
english translation text: Whoever spends upon Sarwar's mourning\nfor as long as he lives—\nincrease the sustenance of every servant of Shabbir.

arabic text: ZAINAB KI LAHAD PER KABHI ZINDAAN ME JAAKAR\nMATAM KARE KHUL KAR\nASBAAB ZARA SHAAM POHNCHNE KE BANA DO
english translation text: Let us one day go to the prison\nand openly perform matam at Zainab's grave. Create\nthe means for us to reach Shaam.

arabic text: GHAYBAT ME HAI IS WAQT JO ALLAH KI HUJJAT\nHO US KI ZIYARAT\nPARDE JO TAKALLUM KI NIGAAHON SE HATA DO
english translation text: May we behold Allah's Proof\nwho is now in occultation. Remove\nthe veils from Taqallum's sight.

arabic text: HAR DIL ME YAA HUSSAIN, HAR DIL ME KARBALA
english translation text: Ya Hussain within every heart; Karbala within every heart.

arabic text: SHABIR KI MADAR NE, MAANGI THI JO KHALIQ SE\nUSKA HAI YE SILA
english translation text: This is the fulfilment of what\nShabbir's mother asked from the Creator.

arabic text:
KAABA HO NAJAF HO YA WHO SHEHRE MADINA HO
WOH SHEHR E KHORASAN HO SAMARRA HO KUFA HO
DUNYA KA KOI QARYA YA KOI BHI KONA HO
AASHOOR PE CHEHLUM PE
AATE HAIN JAHAA(N) BHAR SE
DETE HUWE SADA
english translation text:
Whether the Kaaba, Najaf, Madina,
Khurasan, Samarra or Kufa, or
any village and corner
of the world— on Ashura
and Arbaeen, people come
from everywhere, raising this cry.

arabic text:
NO LAAKH IK TARAF THE AUR IK TARAF BAHATTAR
EK DUSHMAN E KHUDA THE AUR EK KHUDA KA LASKHAR
ZAALIM YE CHAHTE THE MIT JAAYE NAAM E SARWAR
DEKHEIN YE JAHAAN WAALE
CHODA SO BARAS GUZRE
BAAQI HAI BA KHUDA
english translation text:
Nine hundred thousand stood on one side
and seventy-two on the other. One was
God's enemy and the other God's
army. The tyrants wished Sarwar's name erased.
Let the world behold: fourteen centuries
have passed, yet by God it remains.

arabic text:
EK BAAR KARBALA ME KARTA JO ARBAEEN HAI
MANZAR JO DEKHTA HAI WHO BHOOLTA NAHI HAI
JIN O BASHAR MALAAIK SAB KI JHUKI JABEEN HAI
KOI NAHI YAZEEDI
HAR SHAKHS HAI HUSAINI
JO BHI WAHAAN MILA
english translation text:
Whoever performs Arbaeen once in
Karbala never forgets what they
witness. Jinn, humans and
angels bow their heads there.
No Yazidi is found;
every person there is Hussaini.

arabic text:
JAB ARZ E NAYNAWA SE MAIN LOT KAR HON AYA
GHAZI KI SALTANAT KA LOGO NE HAAL POOCHA
LAFZO ME KIS TARHA SE ME YE BAYAAN KARTA
MAINE BAGHAIR SAMJHE
MAINE BAGHAYR SOCHE
BAS ITNA KEH DIYA
english translation text:
When I returned from
Nainawa, people asked about
Ghazi's kingdom. How could
I explain it in words?
Without thinking or understanding,
I simply said this much:

arabic text:
DILMEIN RAKHI HAI TUM NE SHABIR SE ADAWAT
MAJLIS KO MEHFILON KO KEHTE RAHE HO BID’AT
ROZ E HISAB HOGI IS PER TUME NIDAMAT
LOGON BA ROZE MEHSHAR
HONGE SABHI PAYAMBAR
TAB TUM YE DEKHNA
english translation text:
You keep hatred for Shabbir within your hearts
and call the majlis and gatherings innovation.
On Judgement Day you will regret this.
On the plain of Resurrection,
all the prophets will be present;
then you will see.

arabic text:
MAIDAA(N) ME BE KAFAN THA SHAAHE HUDA KA
LAASHA
SARWAR KI LAASH PER WHO, SAIDAANIO KA GIRYA
SEENE SE SHAHE DEEN KE HAT TI NA THI SAKINA
ROTA YEH AASMAN HAI
GIRYA KUNAA JAHAAN HAI
PUR DARD HAI FIZA
english translation text:
The body of the King of
guidance lay unshrouded in the battlefield.
The Sayyid ladies wept upon Sarwar's
body. Sakina would not move from
the King's chest. The heavens
wept, the world lamented, and the
atmosphere was filled with pain.

arabic text:
BARHTI HI JAA RAHI HAI KARBOBALA KI CHAHAT
HAI ARSALAN ITNI SHABIR SE MOHABAT
PUCHO KAREEM KOI KAISI HAI RAB KI JANNAT
PEHCHAN MUKHTASAR HAI
JANNAT ME JO BHI GHAR HAI
HOGA ALAM LAGA
english translation text:
The love of Karbala continues to
grow. O Arsalan, such is the
love for Shabbir. Ask Karim what
God's Paradise is like: its brief
sign is that every home in
Paradise will bear a standard.

arabic text: DARYA SE NO LAUTA, SAQQA E SAKINA
english translation text: Sakina's water-bearer did not return from the river.

arabic text: HAI KHOON ME DOOBA, SAQQA E SAKINA
english translation text: Sakina's water-bearer is submerged in blood.

arabic text: SHABBIR SE BOLE, ABBAS YE ROKAR\nTAZEEM KARU ME KIS TARHA SE UTHKAR\nMAJBOOR HAI MOLA, SAQQA E SAKINA
english translation text: Weeping, Abbas said to Shabbir:\nhow can I rise to honour you?\nMaula, Sakina's water-bearer is helpless.

arabic text: SHARMINDA HOON MOLA, SAB BEH GAYA PAANI\nMASOOM SAKINA, REH JAAEGI PYAASI\nAB MUJHKO NA KEHNA, SAQQA E SAKINA
english translation text: I am ashamed, Maula; all the water has spilled.\nInnocent Sakina will remain thirsty.\nDo not call me Sakina's water-bearer again.

arabic text: NA HAATH SALAAMAT, NA MASHK SALAMAT\nKHADIM PE TUMHARE, HAI KAISI QAYAMAT\nAB UTH NA SAKEGA, SAQQA E SAKINA
english translation text: Neither hands nor water-skin remain intact.\nWhat a Judgement Day has befallen your servant.\nSakina's water-bearer will never rise again.

arabic text: RONE LAGE BACHE, KUZO(N) KO CHUPAKAR\nJIS WAQT BATAYA SHABBIR NE AAKAR\nMAARA GAYA PYAASA, SAQQA E SAKINA
english translation text: The children wept, hiding their little cups,\nwhen Shabbir returned and told them:\nSakina's water-bearer was killed thirsty.

arabic text: PARCHAM SE LIPAT KAR, BOLI YE SAKINA\nLAUT AAWO KE PAANI MANGUNGI KABHI NA\nAY FADHL KE BABA, SAQQA E SAKINA
english translation text: Clinging to the standard, Sakina said:\nreturn—I will never ask for water again.\nO father of Fadl, Sakina's water-bearer.

arabic text: SAR PEETKE HAAYE, ZAINAB YE PUKARI\nTHA AY MERE BHAI TU AAS HUMAARI\nAB LAUT KE AAJA, SAQQA E SAKINA
english translation text: Beating her head, Zainab cried:\nO my brother, you were our hope.\nReturn now, Sakina's water-bearer.

arabic text: IS TARHA TO BE BAS, DEKHA NA KISI KO\nGHORE SE ZAMEEN PER, JIS TARHA GIRA WHO\nBE DAST GIRA THA, SAQQA E SAKINA
english translation text: No one was ever seen so helpless:\nthe way he fell from the horse to the ground,\nSakina's water-bearer fell without hands.

arabic text: ABBAS KI GHURBAT, ABBAS SUNAAEY\nZEESHAN MERA DIL, PHAT JAEGA HAYE\nMAZLOOM HAI ITNA, SAQQA E SAKINA
english translation text: To describe Abbas's loneliness is to hear Abbas himself.\nO Zeeshan, my heart will split apart.\nSo oppressed was Sakina's water-bearer.

arabic text: YA MAZLOOM HUSSAIN
english translation text: O oppressed Hussain.

arabic text:
HAAYE ASHOOR KA DIN, HAAYE GHAREEB E ZAHRA
QATL SAB HOGAYA, MAQTAL ME KHARE HAIN TANHA
APNE PYARON SE JUDA HO CHUKE HAYE MOLA
NA HAI ABBAS SA BHAI NA BHATEEJA BETE
ROKE ZAHRA NE KAHA AY MERE MAZLOOM HUSSAIN
TERA KOI NA RAHA, AY MERE MEHROOM HUSSAIN
english translation text:
Alas, the day of Ashura; alas, Zahra's lonely son.
All have been killed, and he stands alone in the battlefield.
He has been separated from every beloved.
Neither Abbas-like brother, nephew nor son remains.
Weeping, Zahra said: O my oppressed Hussain,
no one remains for you, O my deprived Hussain.

arabic text: YA MAZLOOM HUSSAIN, YA MEHROOM HUSSAIN\nYA GHAREEB E ZAHRA
english translation text: O oppressed Hussain, O deprived Hussain,\nO lonely son of Zahra.

arabic text: BARSARE KARBOBALA AATI HAI BAS EK SADA
english translation text: Across Karbala, only one cry is heard.

arabic text:
SAB HUWE QATL RAHA KOI NA HAYE BETA
AB BHALA KAUN TERA SAATH NIBHAAE BETA MEIN
TERE SAATH GAYI, SAATH TERE HI AAYI
TU NE LAASH JO BAHATTAR KE UTHAAE BETA
english translation text:
All have been killed; no one remains, my son.
Who will now remain loyal beside you, my son?
I went with you and returned with you.
You lifted the bodies of all seventy-two, my son.

arabic text:
LAASHE AKBAR JO UTHAATE HUWE DEKHA MAINE
TUJHKO GIRTE HUWE HAR BAAR SAMBHALA MAINE
HAAYE JAB UTH NA SAKA TUJH SE JAWAA’N KA
LAASHA
LAASHA AKBAR KA TERE SATH UTHAYA MAINE
english translation text:
I watched you lifting Akbar's body
and steadied you every time you
fell. When you could no longer
lift the young man's body, I
lifted Akbar's body beside you.

arabic text:
TUM JO DARYA KI TARAF DEKH RAHE HO ROKAR
APNE GHAZI KO BULATE HO MUJHE BHI HAI KHABAR
UTHKE AA SAKTA NAHI HAATH NAHIN HAIN USKTE
WHO BHI DARYA PE TARAPTA HAI TERE RONE PAR
QATL DARYA KE KINARE JO HUWE WHO PYASE
KIS TARHA AUN O MUHAMMAD KE UTHAAE LAASHE
english translation text:
You look towards the river and weep,
calling your Ghazi—I know this too.
He cannot rise; he has no hands.
He too writhes beside the river when you cry.
Those killed beside the river died thirsty.
How did you lift the bodies of Aun and Muhammad?

arabic text: TERE HAATHO’N PE LAGA TEER ALI ASGHAR KA\nTU NE QASIM KE UTHAAE HAI ZAMEE’N SE TUKRE
english translation text: Ali Asghar's arrow struck your hands,\nand you lifted Qasim's pieces from the ground.

arabic text:
HAAYE DORANE SADA TEER LAGA MAATHE PAR
KHAAK PER AAGAYE GHORE SE JANAAB E SARWAR
AASMAA’N KAANP UTHA AUR ZAMEE’N RONE LAGI
LEKE AAGHOSH ME JAB MAA NE KAHAA RO RO KAR
english translation text:
Alas, as you cried out, an arrow struck your forehead.
The noble Sarwar fell from his horse upon the dust.
The heavens trembled and the earth began to weep,
when his mother held him and cried:

arabic text:
SHIMR KE HAATH ME DEKHA JO CHAMKTA KHANJAR
RAKH DIYA APNA GALA MA NE GULU E DIL PAR
JAB BACHA PAAYI NAHI KHUSHK GALA BETE HAI
BAYN KARTI THI YEHI KHAAK URHA KAR MADAR
english translation text:
When Mother saw the shining dagger in Shimr's hand,
she placed her own throat upon her beloved's throat.
Unable to save her son's dry neck,
she scattered dust and recited this lament.

arabic text:
HAI WHO ZEESHAN HUSSAIN APNE WATAN SE
MEHROOM
JISKA SAR AB BHI HAI ABBAS BADAN SE MEHROOM
MOJIZA KARBOBALA JAAKE YEH HUMNE DEKHA
WHO KAFAN DETA HAI JO KHUD HAI BADAN SE
MEHROOM
english translation text:
O Zeeshan, Hussain is deprived of his
homeland; just as his head remains separated
from Abbas, his body is deprived of
its head. We witnessed this miracle upon
visiting Karbala: he grants shrouds to others
while his own body remains without one.
